_README: Code-intelligence MCP scaffold. DISABLED by default: the active .mcp.json is empty because a code graph over a docs-only repo adds noise and can cost MORE tokens than it saves if misconfigured (see docs/09). At P0, once real code exists, copy ONE of the servers below into .mcp.json, install it, and MEASURE token/tool-call impact before trusting it.
_when: Enable at P0 (docs/08 roadmap), not before.

_options.serena: LSP -> MCP: symbol-level retrieval/editing via a language server. Best once the TS/JS stack is chosen. https://github.com/oraios/serena
_options.local-code-graph: Local-first precomputed graph over MCP (e.g. CodeGraph / codebase-memory-mcp). No cloud, no embeddings API.

serena._note: Example only — lives in .mcp.example.json, NOT loaded. Move into .mcp.json to enable. Verify the command/args against Serena's current README before use.
